article.story: NORTH CHARLESTON, S.C. -- — Del Jones had 27 points in Radford's 84-75 victory against Charleston Southern on Thursday. Jones shot 8 for 22 (1 for 3 from 3-point range) and 10 of 10 from the free-throw line for the Highlanders (12-11, 5-3 Big South Conference). Jaylon Johnson scored 18 points and added six rebounds. Dennis Parker Jr. had 16 points and shot 4 of 10 from the field, including 2 for 4 from 3-point range, and went 6 for 11 from the line. A'lahn Sumler led the way for the Buccaneers (11-12, 2-6) with 26 points. Charleston Southern also got 14 points and two steals from Brycen Blaine. The Buccaneers extended their losing streak to six straight. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
